typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk, Syne, or Clash Display (sans-serif, tracking-tight, uppercase for impact)
typography.notes: Do not use default fonts for headings. The heading font MUST be bold, geometric, and tightly tracked to give an industrial, high-end techno feel. Use uppercase for section titles.

layouts.general: Asymmetrical, generous spacing (use py-24 or py-32 for sections). Strictly left-aligned text for paragraphs.
layouts.hero: Min-h-screen. Kinetic text reveal. Background image darkened (bg-black/50) with subtle parallax. Massive H1 typography.
layouts.categories: Bento Grid Protocol (MODE A) or a stark, massive list with hover-image reveal. Break out of boring equal squares.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered chapters (e.g., [01] EL EQUIPO). Stark left-aligned text with massive typography and negative space.
layouts.product_catalog: Brutalist grid. Sharp corners (rounded-none). 1px solid border (border-neutral-800). Image containers clipped and properly spaced.
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. E.g., 'ALQUILER DE EQUIPOS • SONIDO PROFESIONAL • EVENTOS Y DJS • '.

motion.on_load: Framer Motion line-by-line text reveal. Wrap text lines in 'overflow-hidden' and animate 'y' from 100% to 0%.
motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling setup in the root App.js (momentum scrolling).
motion.hover_states: Product images scale up slightly on hover. Borders shift to yellow on hover. Buttons should have crisp, sharp interactions.
motion.parallax: Apply subtle vertical translation on images as the user scrolls.

components.whatsapp_button: Floating button (bottom-right). Primary yellow background, black text/icon. High z-index. Must link to 'https://wa.me/34600000000'. Include WhatsApp icon from react-icons (FaWhatsapp) or lucide-react.
components.product_card: Include: High-quality image, Title, Category Label, Approximate price (e.g., 'Desde 120€ / día'), and a WhatsApp contact button specifically for that product.
components.marquee_bar: Use react-fast-marquee or custom CSS. Dark background, yellow text, or vice versa.
components.navigation: Sticky header (z-50) with backdrop-blur-xl and solid border-b. Logo on left, navigation links, and CTA on right.

image_urls.description: Dark close-up of a pioneer DJ mixing console. Perfect for the main hero or Mixers category.
Large line array speakers suspended. Use for 'Altavoces' section.
DJ controller with hands/laptop. Use for 'Reproductores/Controladoras MIDI'.
Full stage with lights and setup. Use for 'Equipo Completo' package.
Abstract purple/orange event lights and cabling. Use for 'Otros'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white/yellow text over background images has sufficient contrast by applying a dark overlay (e.g., bg-black/60) to the images.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for Framer Motion animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: MUST build components and views using React (.js files, NOT .tsx).
Install required dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion lenis react-fast-marquee lucide-react react-icons`.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling in App.js.
Create a 'SonidoPro' visual catalog. The UI should look like an Awwwards-winning site: raw, industrial, premium.
DO NOT use generic Shadcn cards if they ruin the aesthetic. Build custom, sharp-edged (rounded-none) brutalist cards with 1px border for products.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements, especially the WhatsApp buttons and navigation links.
Include approximate prices for products, explicitly highlighting items >100€/día.
The primary WhatsApp button should float. Each product card should also have a WhatsApp button.
Do not invent fake placeholder image URLs. Use EXACTLY the image URLs provided in this document.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all).
Do NOT center align the app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Only use provided URLs.
